name: Uzziel
overview: Uzziel was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, uniquely identified as the son of Bela. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture provides no further notes or distinguishing attributes about him. His mention is brief and focused on his lineage within the Benjaminite tribe.
namesAndTitles: The name Uzziel means "G-d [El] is [my] strength," reflecting a common Old Testament practice of embedding faith in God within personal names. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 7:7 and was not given directly by God but carries a significant theistic meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Uzziel is explicitly recorded as the son of Bela, who is also a member of the tribe of Benjamin. Scripture does not provide additional family relationships or descendants for Uzziel beyond this father-son connection.
scriptureSignificance: Uzziel's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin, as the son of Bela. This connection situates him within the broader narrative of Israel's tribal history, which is foundational for understanding the lineage and heritage of God's people. While not prominent in other biblical events, his inclusion preserves the continuity of the Benjaminite line.
